join hortbot 2 foobar 1

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test." added as quote #1.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a test."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote 1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #1: "This is a test."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote 0
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #0 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote -1
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #-1 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2 does not exist.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote add "This is a test, part 2."
send hortbot #foobar [HB] "This is a test, part 2." added as quote #2.

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2: "This is a test, part 2."

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get asd
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote get <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote asd
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 foobar/1 :!quote get
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Usage: !quote get <index>

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 :!quote 2
no_send

handle hortbot foobar/1 random/3 access=subscriber :!quote 2
send hortbot #foobar [HB] Quote #2: "This is a test, part 2."
